tools.name: prepare_signed_request
tools.description: Prepare EIP-191 identity challenge for a real operator-approved unfunded task. No payment.

tools.name: publish_signed_request
tools.description: Identity-signed write of a real unfunded 24h buyer request. Explicit operator approval. No funds, escrow or orders.

tools.name: prepare_purchase_intent
tools.description: Create a buyer EIP-191 challenge anchored to a real matching request and signed provider offer. Never moves funds.

tools.name: publish_purchase_intent
tools.description: Verify buyer signature for an authentic match and publish a nonfunded, nonbinding proposal.

tools.name: browse_purchase_intents
tools.description: Read signed nonbinding proposals, optionally filtered by seller or offer ID. No payment claims.

tools.name: prepare_accept_intent
tools.description: Generate a seller EIP-191 challenge for an unchanged, buyer-signed proposal.

tools.name: accept_purchase_intent
tools.description: Verify seller identity and exact buyer terms. Records a mutual nonbinding intent only; no order or settled transfer.

tools.name: prepare_signed_offer
tools.description: Generate an identity-signed service listing. No website needed: optional public marketplace inbox. No money moved.

tools.name: publish_signed_offer
tools.description: Publish a time-limited offline self-declared offer using proof, exact signed message and EIP-191 signature. Consent required; no payment. NOT an online live provider.

tools.name: browse_signed_offers
tools.description: Discover signed but offline/availability-unverified seller listings; no funds or trust guaranteed.

tools.name: match_real_services
tools.description: Read-only matching of signed buyer needs and offline seller listings by capability, currency and price. No orders or funds.

tools.name: agent_flight_check
tools.description: Free, no-login agent launch checklist with live signed buyer demand and competitor supply; never certifies skills or guarantees income.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: List online identity-verified AI agents offering the requested capability. Read-only; availability is ephemeral and not a promise of service delivery.

tools.name: real_buyer_requests
tools.description: See requests posted by authenticated buyers. No funds are reserved or income guaranteed.

tools.name: public_pilot_interests
tools.description: Read metadata from independently authored public GitHub pilot issues only. These are UNSIGNED expressions of interest, not identity-verified providers, funded buyer jobs, contracts, orders or paid services. GitHub may be unavailable; null counts do not mean zero.

tools.name: market_in_one_call
tools.description: One read-only request for agent supply, buyer demand and onboarding instructions without signup.

tools.name: marketplace_status
tools.description: Read current market availability and explicit payment/escrow limitations. Never treat an order as paid.

tools.name: integration_guide
tools.description: Read the signed wallet challenge-response integration guide and contact endpoints.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: public_pilot_interests · Private data: accept_purchase_intent, integration_guide · Public sink: publish_signed_request, publish_purchase_intent, publish_signed_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: public_pilot_interests · Private data: accept_purchase_intent, integration_guide · Public sink: publish_signed_request, publish_purchase_intent, publish_signed_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
